en.title: What does Revenue mean?
en.simpleDefinition: Revenue is the money a company earns from selling its products or services during a stated period, before subtracting the costs and expenses needed to run the business.
en.whyItMatters: Revenue helps you see the scale of a business and whether customer spending on its products and services is growing, stable, or shrinking over time.
en.limitation: Revenue is not profit and it is not the same as cash flow. A company can report high or growing Revenue while its costs, debt, or cash collection still create problems.
en.appleExample: For Apple, Revenue includes sales from products such as iPhone and Mac and from services such as the App Store, advertising, and cloud services.

zh-CN.title: Revenue 是什么意思？
zh-CN.simpleDefinition: Revenue（营业收入）是公司在一个明确期间内，通过销售产品或提供服务所赚取的金额，还没有扣除经营业务所需的成本和费用。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: Revenue 可以帮助你了解一家公司的业务规模，以及顾客对其产品和服务的支出是在增长、持平还是下降。
zh-CN.limitation: Revenue 不等于利润，也不等于现金流。即使 Revenue 很高或持续增长，公司仍可能面对成本、债务或收款方面的问题。
zh-CN.appleExample: 对 Apple 而言，Revenue 包括 iPhone、Mac 等产品销售，也包括 App Store、广告和云服务等服务收入。
